title: Linked List: Insert at Beginning
summary: Add a new node at the front of a singly linked list in constant time by re-pointing the head.

anchors.label: Point the new node at the old head
Move head to the new node

practice.note: The list arrives as `head`, the first ListNode (None in Python, null in JavaScript when the list is empty). A ListNode has `val` and `next`. Return the head of the list after adding the value at the front.
